i18n.description: Internationalization policy. locale_codes defines all language codes recognized as valid translation zones. Files inside <lang-code>/ or locales/<lang-code>/ directories, and *_<lang-code> suffix files (e.g. README_ko.md, tracked by hash-sync), are exempt from the English-only documentation rule. en is the source language, not a translation-zone target.

country_scoped_assets.description: Skills, scripts, env keys, and variant asset directories whose function is specific to one country/region because they access that country's data systems (NOT language-based). Never register language skills (translate etc.) here.

variant_scoped_skills.description: Skills whose function is exclusive to ONE variant. Registry-only SSOT (owner-curated — heuristics cannot distinguish these from genuinely common skills). _notes.static_only: This section carries static declarations ONLY (design §2.2). Dynamic per-hub state (bootstrap/operational states, TTL leases, degraded_capabilities, state_history) lives in each hub repo's .pipeline-state/hub-<name>.state.json following the gitignored local-state convention; the root NEVER writes it. The root observes hub state via the weekly read-only probe (lifecycle-manager), which records observed values + head hash into docs/reports/YYYY-MM-DD-hub-probe-<hub>.md (keep-latest-N=4 per hub).
_notes.state_ref: state_ref (on entries) is hub-local and unresolvable from the root BY DESIGN (design §2.3): the root repo cannot read another project's local .pipeline-state/ directory. The field exists so root-side tooling can NAME the expected state location and so the probe can report which file it read; a dangling state_ref at the root is normal operation, not an error.
_notes.entry_shape: entries[] rows: {asset, domain (enum domains), hub_variant, category (enum categories), verticals[], origin, canonical_path, version (semver), consumers[] of {variant, minimum_version}, hub_remote, state_ref}. hub-doctrine consumers declare consumption and hold no copies; variant-identity assets are kept locally in their owning variant AND registered (promotion must never overwrite them with a thinner copy).
_notes.hub_shape: hubs[] rows: {name, hub_remote, capabilities[] (subset of capability_enum keys — a hub cannot declare or degrade into a capability the enum does not know), minimum_version_policy}.
_notes.consumer_enforcement: Consuming variants declare {domain, minimum_version} in their variant.json hub.consumes block; the validate-templates.ts hub legs and the audit.ts hub-resolve checker FAIL when a declared minimum_version exceeds the corresponding registry entry's version (semver compare). The checks are vacuously green while entries[] is empty and activate as promotion batches B-D land registry rows.
_notes.known_unregistered_duplicates: Declared soak inventory of cross-variant asset copies that predate the registry (baseline scan at registry landing, 2026-11-01; same finding class as the co-develop/co-security security-suite fork of the 2026-10-31 audit). validate-templates.ts hub-dup-unregistered WARNs on duplicates present in this inventory and FAILs on any duplicate absent from BOTH entries[] and this inventory — new undeclared forks fail closed immediately. Rows must be retired (registered into entries[] or commonized per the >=3-convergence rule) by promotion batches B-D; a row whose duplication no longer exists on disk WARNs as stale so the inventory shrinks to empty. Retired to empty at batch E④ (2026-11-01): all 14 baseline rows were adjudicated into entries[] (1 hub-doctrine + 28 variant-identity rows); the key is retained as an empty array because the hub-topology-shape leg requires it.
_notes.l1_common_exclusion: Skills/agents delivered by the L1 common contract (docs/templates/common-contract.json common_skills/common_agents) are intentionally present in every variant and are NOT cross-variant duplication; the duplicate legs exclude them by name.
_notes.fan_in_rule: Hub selection is provisional on measured fan-in (design §9): an asset consumed by >=2 OTHER variants qualifies. The registry is data-driven — the roster re-pins if fleet reports contradict it.
_notes.identity_domains: Identity domains (batch E④): domains[] lists the three hub domains first, then the identity domains of non-hub variants that hold registered variant-identity assets. A domain here names an asset-ownership scope, NOT hub status — only a variant listed in hubs[] (with a variant.json hub block, role: hub) is a hub; identity-domain entries carry no consumers and no delegation surface. Added because retiring the soak required registering cross-variant copies that live outside the three hub domains.
